DLC2309:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...People fight with everything they have, hang on for all they're worth, and when even that isn't enough, they seek a savior...」

DLC2309:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I'm about to tell takes place a month after $$サイデリアル$$ began its invasion... just as the fronts across the world were finally starting to collapse.」

DLC2309:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even then, those who refused to give up kept fighting, with hope in their hearts.」

DLC2309:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This time, I bring you a heartwarming story born on one of those hellish battlefields.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:3.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Quit dragging your feet, you beaten dogs! Hurry up and follow our directions!」

DLC2309:3:t_2:6.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Do you people understand what position you're in?」

DLC2309:3:t_2:7.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「It's true that the Empire defeated our unit. But you haven't broken our spirits!」

DLC2309:3:t_2:8.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Even if we fall here, others will take our place! And they'll free this planet from your clutches!」

DLC2309:3:t_2:10.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「You're still resisting?! Then we'll use force...!」

DLC2309:3:t_2:11.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Stop. Our mission is to capture soldiers alive while they still have the will to resist.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:12.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「They have the will, but they don't have the means. Keep your cool and handle it.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:14.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Come on. We're transferring you to $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:15.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「The imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$... So the rumors were true. That's where they send the survivors...」

DLC2309:3:t_2:16.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Then that suits me fine. If you're taking us right to the Emperor's doorstep, we'll raise hell there.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:17.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Remember this, $$新地球皇国$$! One day, someone will come along who can beat you!」

DLC2309:3:t_2:18.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Once the beast wind starts blowing, it'll blow you bastards away in an instant!」

DLC2309:3:t_2:19.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「...Good grief... You'd never know which side lost the battle...」

DLC2309:3:t_2:20.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「This planet really is abnormal. Normally, anyone beaten this badly would have surrendered unconditionally long ago...」

DLC2309:3:t_2:21.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Where were you stationed before you came here?」

DLC2309:3:t_2:22.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「The Eighth Frontier District. The planets in its fourth solar system lost all will to fight in ten days.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:23.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「My last posting was Planet Kyou in the Omega Cluster. They put up a fight, but even there, the outcome was settled in a month.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:24.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「This isn't just a matter of how much fighting strength they have left. This planet can keep resisting because of the way its people think.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:26.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「That's right. It explains why Lord $$アウストラリス$$ and the three chief executives came here in person.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:27.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Still, there's a limit. Once we crush all their fighting forces, the resistance will come to an end.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:30.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「That beast wind the resistance kid mentioned...」

DLC2309:3:t_2:31.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「That's just a rumor they made up.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:32.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「But a unit an acquaintance of mine belonged to was wiped out by that beast wind...」

DLC2309:3:t_2:34.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「I visited him the other day, and he kept deliriously muttering about a beast... a wind...」

DLC2309:3:t_2:38.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「If this beast wind shows up, I'll just have to beat it at its own game.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:39.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「You'd better get fired up, too. It's your chance to avenge your friend.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:40.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「...You've changed... You used to just go through the motions on every assignment.」

DLC2309:3:t_2:41.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Maybe this planet's craziness has rubbed off on me, too...」

DLC2309:3:t_3:3.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「...Thanks to you, we found our chance to escape. You have our gratitude.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:4.en:
$$獣人$$
「Don't mention it, brother. We're comrades fighting the same enemy.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:6.en:
$$獣人$$
「We're in this together now! Let's join forces and kick those Imperial bastards' asses!」

DLC2309:3:t_3:7.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Understood! We're counting on you!」

DLC2309:3:t_3:8.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...Then $$大グレン団$$ will join up with the Beastmen and continue fighting here.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's the plan. The resistance fighters we rescued will help us, too.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:10.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Thanks for everything you've done for us, $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:11.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Oh, not at all... For you, $$ヨーコ$$, I'd be happy to keep taking care of you well into your old age...」

DLC2309:3:t_3:13.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...But this is hardly the time for jokes like that.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:14.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Where is $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ going next?」

DLC2309:3:t_3:15.en:
$$葵$$
「It sounds like $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ plans to head for Central Asia.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:17.en:
$$葵$$
「Our target is the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:18.en:
$$くらら$$
「But charging in with only $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ really would be suicide...」

DLC2309:3:t_3:19.en:
$$朔哉$$
「We're going to lay the groundwork for a battle there.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:20.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「I see. You're going to wait for them to arrive.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:21.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Of course. I'm sure they're thinking along the same lines.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:22.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「We usually like to make a splash, but this time, we'll be the ones quietly doing the heavy lifting.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:23.en:
$$シモン$$
「Got it. Once things settle down on this front, we'll head for Central Asia, too.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:24.en:
$$葵$$
「We'll be waiting, $$シモン$$. Let's fight together again.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:25.en:
$$シモン$$
「When we do, let's give them another taste of the beast-and-wind team that had the Imperial troops shaking in their boots.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:26.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
（The beast and the wind... And water and fire...）

DLC2309:3:t_3:27.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
（The blood of the beast, the mingling of water, the destination of the wind, the civilization of fire... All lead toward the radiance of the sun...）

DLC2309:3:t_3:28.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
（Let us trust that it will guide us...）

DLC2309:3:t_3:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The blood of the beast and the destination of the wind... It seems their influence was felt quite strongly within the Empire as well as on Earth's side.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... If more soldiers turn out like our Imperial soldier here, the fighting may grow even fiercer.」

DLC2309:3:t_3:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Whatever the case, their actions certainly set great changes in motion throughout the world...」

DLC2309:3:t_3:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone... Until we meet again.」

DLC2309:4:t_000:1.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Once we've delivered the prisoners to $$ラース・バビロン$$, I'm putting in for a transfer.」

DLC2309:4:t_000:2.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「I'm going to the front lines to fight this planet's warriors. And then...」

DLC2309:4:t_000:3.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「You can talk later! Something's coming!」

DLC2309:4:t_001:1.en:
$$獣人$$
「Let's do this! Whip up a storm!」

DLC2309:4:t_002:0.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Tch! They've come to take the prisoners back!」

review.context: Imperial captors discuss Earth resistance and the beast wind; Team Dai-Gurren parts from the Dancouga team while planning the Wrath Babylon assault.
decisions: The beast wind is the soldiers' descriptive rumor, tying Dancouga's beast motif to Team Dai-Gurren's wind motif.
The transfer-seeking soldier is energized by Earth's resistance rather than abandoning the Empire.
